title: US-10 DFD: add missing ingredients

flows.label: Owned recipe id and access token
Existing shopping names and stable ids
200 resulting shopping-item array or access error

rules: All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
Trim and case-normalize ingredient names for comparison only. Missing names are unique recipe names absent from the fridge; existing shopping names are not inserted again.
Repeated/concurrent requests use owner/name uniqueness and retain existing item ids. An empty missing set is a successful no-op.
No inventory write occurs: recipe, shopping, favorite and history actions never deduct or restock fridge ingredients.
